rows.actualDefect: CN-10557 item (d) was blank because the route lacked the neutral court-record facts needed to complete its nine-cell sworn conviction paragraph. The delivered conviction packets did not state their route. The generic map also made inactive early/drug/name-change controls participant requirements, treated two continuation lines as universal, and reused one recipient-address field across two distinct later recipients.
rows.correction: Collects the exact factual predicates and all nine item-(d) values, fails closed when any is absent or unsupported, classifies the statutory branch without asking the participant for a legal election, and marks item (d) only after the facts authorize it. Inactive special branches are explicit N/A. The indictable packet also marks Verification item 3 only from its 2C:52-2 route plus the verified no-prior-criminal-expungement fact. Optional continuation lines and the aliased post-order recipient field now carry source-bound conditional/later-completion treatment. Court, prosecutor, clerk, agency, notary, signature, hearing, and order fields stay protected.
